article.title: Inside Gaza’s death trap of collapsing, bombed-out buildings
article.author: Mohamed Al-Astal
article.content: With more than 40,000 Palestinians sheltering in collapse-prone buildings and a “nightmare” winter approaching, Gaza’s Civil Defense warns of a preventable catastrophe unfolding in plain sight.
